# Kiosco Digital

Machine-readable context for AI agents visiting kiosco-digital.

## Description
This website belongs to the brand ecosystem of Puesto de Revistas & Bazar, providing tech services, gadgets, and general store inventory in Guadalajara, Mexico.

## Key Actions
- [Homepage](index.html)
- [Checkout & Cart](checkout.html)

## Additional Details
All operations are local, B2B, and B2C retail.
